feeds.title: The Existential Buddhist
feeds.description: Founded in 2010, The Existential Buddhist publishes essays on Buddhist philosophy, ethics, history, psychology, art, meditation, and social activism. It is non-sectarian, exploring Buddhism from the point of view of reason and lived experience, rather than from adherence to dogma and/or spiritual authority.

feeds.title: Leon's Existential Cafe Blog
feeds.description: This blog explores and helps others navigate through, issues that are pertinent to all human beings, from death to self-esteem. Ideas are medicine. This is started by Leon, whose mission is to help guide others through issues relating to death, self-esteem, relationships, life meaning, and authenticity.

feeds.title: Blog of the Apa » Existentialism
feeds.description: The section covers all the posts related to existentialism. Blog of the Apa is the Official Blog of the American Philosophical Association. We share a variety of perspectives from a broad array of APA members, to highlight the activities being undertaken by the APA, as well as provide a forum where the APA leadership and membership can communicate with one another more effectively.

feeds.title: Skeleton-Man
feeds.description: Follow the Skeleton-Man Blog for all the entertainment and existentialism. Skeleton-Man offers a show on existentialism to encourage living our most rewarding life and DJ.

feeds.title: The Existentialist Blog
feeds.description: This website started as an outlet for thoughts and art. The main goal was to help continue creating my meaning in life. I have written a few blog posts about my life more in-depth, not just my personal life, but what fascinates me in art and philosophy, especially in the present day.

feeds.title: UK Sartre Society » Existentialism
feeds.description: UK Sartre Society posts about existentialism written by Beck Pitt. The UK Sartre Society is dedicated to the study and application of French existentialism and phenomenology, focusing primarily on the works of Simone de Beauvoir and Jean-Paul Sartre.

feeds.title: Eternalised » Existentialism
feeds.description: Existentialism blogs explain different feelings like emptiness, nothingness, meaninglessness, despair, and more. Read Eternalized in pursuit of making a blog to understand human beings in detail! This page offers information on human psychology and how it works at different stages and situations. You can also find book reviews on such topics.
